messages:
maria: quick pulse — I started a sweep of the HelloEdge quickstart. Found two recurring issues: the auth snippet still references SDK v4 env var names, and the Dockerfile uses an old base image causing a runtime error on mac m1 CI. tagging folks who touched the guide last month.
ash: thanks! can you paste the exact lines? happy to fix the SDK bits.
mar ia: oops typo above — maria: sorry. SDK mismatch is in the 'Authenticate' section: we show export REDWOOD_API_KEY instead of the new REDWOOD_KEY (SDK v5+). Also example JS uses `redwood.client()` not `new RedwoodClient()` which leads to runtime reference error in node.
jonathan: i'll take the Dockerfile base image. Which CI job is failing?
ash: i'll handle the auth text + code snippets. i'll open a PR with both Bash and Node examples corrected, and add a short note about version compatibility.
mar ia: @jonathan the failing job is helloedge/integration (mac-arm). error is `Illegal instruction: 4` on startup after pulling node:14-buster. switching to node:18-slim or ubuntu:22.04 fixed it locally.
jonathan: got it — will switch to node:18-slim and add a comment in the Dockerfile about platform compatibility.
sam: FYI: product asked that the quickstart show the hosted endpoint example and the private deploy snippet side-by-side so customers see both flows. can we do a tiny subsection?
ash: yes, i can add a small panel with two minimal curl examples. keeps page compact.
liz: i noticed some links in the troubleshooting note point to the old RFC page. will add redirects to the new runbook links.
deploy-bot: Deploy scheduled: docs-staging -> prod at 2026-03-26T04:00Z if all checks pass :rocket:
docs-bot: Reminder: PR template requires 'tested on mac-arm' checkbox for quickstarts touching Dockerfiles.
maria: plan: ash opens PR for auth + examples, jonathan opens Dockerfile PR, liz fixes links. i'll add a reviewer checklist and coordinate merge order so the staging deploy picks up everything together.
ash: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1492 — updated auth snippets (bash + node), added short migration note for SDK v4->v5. still needs code sample takedown in friction points.
jonathan: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1493 — Dockerfile -> node:18-slim, added comment about --platform=linux/amd64 for CI where needed. ran integration locally on mac-arm.
liz: link PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1494 — redirects + link cleanups.
sam: nice. maria can you add the hosted vs private curl blurb before we merge? small UX ask from product.
maria: yes i'll add that as a follow-up commit to #1492 today. target to merge both 1492 & 1493 by EOD PST.
ash: quick QA ask — can someone run the helloedge quickstart end-to-end (fresh clone + node install + docker build + sample request) on an M1 laptop? i tested node side but not the full docker flow.
jonathan: i can test on my m1. tagging results back here in ~30m.
jonathan: (30m later) tested full flow on mac m1: build + run + sample request succeeded with node:18-slim and --platform=linux/amd64. added test notes in the PR.
maria: awesome. two more tiny docs asks: 1) add callout about credentials rotation (link to KMS page) 2) add snippet that shows minimal env var names for both hosted and private.
liz: will add the KMS link in 1494.
ash: added a one-liner about credential rotation to 1492.
ash: can we merge once all CI checks pass? i'm happy to handle any quick follow-ups.
docs-bot: CI status: 1492 (checks passing), 1493 (checks passing), 1494 (one link lint warning).
maria: let's wait for link lint fix then merge together. thanks everyone! :heart:
